dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge displays a concave curvature with a localized notch-like indentation in the upper third section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the point of maximum vertical extension.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear margin oriented at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Proportion of approximately 1.0, where height is nearly equal to the visible base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Symmetrical convex curvature with a smooth, medium-radius arc defining the anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust pixel length with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions abruptly to the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive circular high-luminance spot on the dorsal side anterior to the fin; visible notch on the posterior margin of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced polygonal/faceted pixel boundaries on the ventral surface and tail peduncle, characteristic of a digital rendering.
